Kit summary

Stinger AttackBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single enemy. Meanwhile, deals extra 90% ATK [Bleed] DMG. The more layers of [Bleed] the target has, the more extra [Bleed] DMG dealt, up to 180% ATK.
Stinger Cover Lv.1Stinger Attack deals 50% of the original DMG to 2 random enemies.
Lighting StrokeActiveExclusive Lv.2
Increases self ATK by 40% for 2 turns. Afterward, acts 1 extra turn and gains 1 layer of [Scorpion Stinger] for 1 turn, during which Stinger Attack becomes Lightning Stinger.
Stinger Cover Lv.2Increases self Turn Meter by 40% and restores self HP by 20% of self Max HP when Mackin kills an enemy. Meanwhile, reduces the CD of Lighting Stroke by 2 turns.
Rapid TearPassive
The DMG of each stage dealt by Mackin has a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] on the target for 2 turns.
Bloodlust ConnectionPassive
Increases [Bleed] DMG dealt by Mackin by 50%. When an ally enters [Way of Ocean] status, Mackin will enter the same status for 1 turn if he is not under [Way of Ocean] status currently. If Mackin is under [Way of Ocean] status, the [Bleed] DMG increased by Bloodlust Connection will be increased to 150% of the original [Bleed] DMG dealt.
Lightning StingerBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 100% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. Meanwhile, deals extra 90% ATK [Bleed] DMG. The more layers of [Bleed] the target has, the more extra [Bleed] DMG dealt, up to 180% ATK.
Stinger Cover Lv.3Lightning Stinger deals the highest [Bleed] DMG directly. Besides, refreshes the duration of all [Bleed] effects the target has after the DMG is dealt.
